💬 Iran pursues justice for Minab school attack victims at national, international levels

📌 Bandar Abbas, IRNA – Deputy Justice Minister for Human Rights and International Affairs, Askar Jalalian, announces that efforts are being made to seek justice for the victims of the Shajareh Tayyebeh school attack in Minab at both national and international levels.

Jalalian made the remarks during his visit to the Shajareh Tayyebeh school in Minab, Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, on Thursday evening.
​
During his visit, he announced that the Presidential Legal Affairs Office is pursuing legal and judicial proceedings for the victims of the school attack, with all national resources mobilized.
​
The official added that the national registration of the incident site is almost complete, noting that plans are underway to produce a commemorative stamp and include the incident in school textbooks.
​
Jalalian also said that a request had been made for Iran’s Human Rights Headquarters to fully utilize its capabilities in raising international awareness of the Shajareh Tayyebeh school massacre.
​
He emphasized that these initiatives aim to secure the victims’ rights, preserve the incident in the nation’s historical memory, and highlight its significance internationally.
